sample_unit: patients with known-primary cervical lymph node metastases (training and test sets)
models_evaluated: ResNet with CBAM attention module, multi-task with Transformer for clinical features

links.outcome: Junior physician primary-site prediction accuracy with versus without model assistance in real-world CMSCCUP cohort
links.effect: Model achieved Micro-AUC 0.809 and Top-3 accuracy 88% in the real-world cohort (172 cases), significantly improving junior physicians' predictive accuracy (all P<0.001).
links.quote: In a real-world CMSCCUP cohort (172 cases, including 86 CMSCCUP patients and 86 normal controls), the model achieved a Micro-AUC of 0.809 against the gold standard and a Top-3 accuracy of 88%, significantly improving the predictive accuracy of junior physicians (all P<0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates an attention-based multi-task deep learning model on CT images and tests whether providing model assistance improves junior physicians' diagnostic accuracy compared to their unassisted performance in a reader study.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical decision support for junior physicians
